description: Free game-only edge rules. Preserve all existing rules and billing plans.

rules.name: Dino API - reject malformed traffic
rules.expression: (http.host in {"anandvivek.in" "www.anandvivek.in"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/slops/dino/api/") and not (http.request.uri.path eq "/slops/dino/api/plan" and http.request.method eq "POST" and any(http.request.headers["origin"][*] in {"https://anandvivek.in" "https://www.anandvivek.in"}) and any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] eq "application/json") and any(starts_with(http.request.headers["authorization"][*], "Bearer "))))
